describe.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal animal shown in right-facing three-quarter view walking on a pale ground. It has a broad, flat, pale pinkish-tan head with large dark eyes and a wide mouth, six feathery external gills around the neck, a stout arched body whose dorsal surface from the neck to the tail is densely covered in overlapping dark brown rounded scales with lighter edges, pale wrinkled skin on the ventral side, throat, limbs and tail underside, four short thick limbs positioned under the body, and a thick tapering tail extending to the left and partially out of frame.

describe.description: A four-legged creature shown in side and three-quarter front view walking to the right. It has a pale pinkish-tan smooth broad head with large dark eyes, a wide slightly smiling mouth, and feathery pink external gills fanning out from both sides of the head and neck. Its body is low and thick with wrinkled pale skin on the underside and legs, four stout clawed limbs, and a long tapering tail extending to the left out of frame. The entire arched back and top of the tail from behind the head to the tail tip is covered in large overlapping dark brown scales.
